events.credibility_reason: A gap in the main proof was reported (Kalai blog update, 22 Mar 2020; arXiv corrigendum snippet citing a computational error that 'opens a gap in the proof of the main result'); the v7 abstract no longer claims the conjecture, and later work including Ghomi's own (Ghomi-Stavroulakis 2026, Ghomi 2026 pinched/nullity) treats the total-curvature step and the general conjecture as open.

events.ai_basis: The vast majority of results were obtained with the same procedure using an unreleased internal OpenAI model.

why: The statement asks whether the Euclidean isoperimetric inequality holds in every Cartan-Hadamard manifold, all dimensions, so dimension-specific or hypothesis-restricted results (Weil, Croke, Kleiner, Ghomi nullity/pinched, Wheeler pinched, Agnoletto small volume, Chen-Ghomi-Wang dims 5 and 3-9) are cases. The local perturbative theorem concerns only metrics near a Euclidean ball, a changed question (variant); the conditional total-curvature bound proves no isoperimetric statement (none); Kloeckner-Kuperberg's counterexamples drop the ambient hypothesis (variant). Ghomi-Spruck 2019 claimed the whole but carries a specific reported gap, a corrigendum snippet, a retreated v7 abstract and later work by Ghomi himself treating the question as open, so I set it knocked_down despite JGA acceptance; this keeps it from making the problem open_stale. The OpenAI repository's two manuscripts claim all dimensions; only a Lean build of the filling theorem backs them, which is not digestion (F7), so unreviewed, credible absent any identified error. Its README says the model obtained the results: generated. The Chen-Ghomi-Wang acknowledgement ('used in the preparation of this manuscript') names no mathematical contribution, so none.
doubts: Ghomi-Spruck knocked_down rests partly on a search snippet of a corrigendum and on the JGA version not having been opened; if the published version closes the gap it would be digested-whole pre-snapshot. The OpenAI manuscripts are 8 days old with no human reader; the Lean scope covers the CAT(0) filling theorem, and the passage from filling to the domain inequality is not formalized as recorded. The Chen-Ghomi-Wang dims 3-9 AI acknowledgement was not read. The ghomi-stavroulakis-2025-local call (variant vs case) was close.
